newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Sport7 gains four pct of Dutch TV audience in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Sport7 gains four pct of Dutch TV audience in Sept.

text.p: The new Sport7 channel gained a four percent share of the Dutch television audience in September, its first full month of operation.
The NOS audience research unit published the following Dutch television viewing figures for September:
Channel Audience share in pct: Sept 96 Aug 96 Sept 96
NOTES - NL1, NL2 and NL3 are public channels. RTL4, RTL5, Veronica, SBS and Sport7 are commercial channels. Arcade figures are combined total for its TV10 and Music Factory channels.
RTL4 and RTL5 -- Dutch publisher VNU owns 38 pct of both channels, Luxembourg-based CLT owns 61 pct of both.
SBS6 -- Scandinavian Broadcasting System owns 70 pct of SBS6, Dutch publisher De Telegraaf 30 percent.
TV10 and Music Factory -- Both channels are wholly owned units of Dutch media group Wegener Arcade.

Sport7 -- PTT Nederland, ING, Philips Electronics and Dutch TV production firm Endemol each own 19.5 percent stakes in Sport7. Dutch soccer association KNVB has a 10 percent stake and De Telegraaf five percent.
Veronica -- Left the public broadcasting system in 1995 to become a commercial station.
